description:
We are AstroHealth Tech, a team passionate about technology, science, and space exploration.
Our skills includes:

Software Development (TypeScript & Python)

Data Analysis

UI/UX for Intuitive Design

Scientific Technical Report

AI Integration

Problem-solving.

Our goal with Astronaut Health Intelligence (AHI) is to build an intelligent platform that integrates astronaut health data, detects anomalies, and provides AI-assisted insights to support health monitoring and safer space missions.
